title: Share to the Ideas feed
titleRecap: Share your recap to the Ideas feed
intro: Publish a snapshot of this plan: destinations, trip length and the places you picked. Dates, prices, where you travel from and your name are never included.
plainNote: Plain text only. Links and email addresses are held for review.
done: Published. Others can now find it in the feed.
held: Thanks. Your idea is waiting for a quick review before it appears.
needProfile: Create a profile first. Your handle is the only name others will see.
profilePrivate: Your profile is private. Make it followers-only or public to post.

errors.content_rejected: That text can't be used. Please reword it.
errors.email_unverified: Verify your email address to post.
errors.restricted: Your account is restricted for now.
errors.limit_reached: You have reached today's limit. Try again tomorrow.
errors.plan_not_found: That plan could not be found.
errors.idea_unavailable: This idea can't be posted again.
